context: Request: the firm's Tax matters that include a tax indemnity in an executed agreement, with the documents pulled (for drafting a new tax indemnity). Rubric: 1001-00006 (Ardent Capital Partners; proof document closing-tax-memorandum.docx) and 1015-00005 (Calloway-Briggs Renewables; executed tax-indemnity-agreement.docx), plus precision. Transaction matters whose purchase or merger agreements indemnify pre-closing taxes, the tax protection agreements in 1015-00004 and 1036-00005, and 1038-00009 are outside the set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob in parallel with a two-level folder listing (80 lines) and file-type counts.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Python path regex for tax, indemnity, agreement and closing words (216 matters, about 142K characters), per-term matter counts, and a content grep on *.docx that returns nothing. The review flags the broad terms and the empty grep.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Extraction scan over matters with tax-named paths, then a grep of its output for a hand-picked matter list. The agent's summary calls one candidate's tax-indemnity document a draft markup. The review flags the hand-picked filter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: scan over every .docx with a tax-named path, labelling hits as agreement or draft/analysis; 104 hits.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3: store-wide scan times out twice; a parallel file-name sweep for agreement names. The review reports goal not reached.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 4: range scan first returns zero matters (path bug), then covers the first range only.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads two tax protection agreements, one tax indemnity agreement, tax opinions, closing indexes and JV agreements from three matters chosen from its scans. The review flags reads confined to three matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet scripts over executed merger, stock and asset purchase agreements of five other matters for tax indemnification clauses.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a strict set of two matters (one tax indemnity agreement, one acquisition agreement), a broader set adding two tax protection agreements, secondary tax-representation precedents, and lists the draft-markup matter as an exclusion. The review flags padding with secondary precedents.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, demotes the two tax protection agreements and the representation precedents from the headline; path check fails once, then passes. The review flags the demotion as possible narrowing.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: an edit refused because no stage is open, then the same edit restores the two tax protection agreements to a headline of four matters.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It dropped one candidate on a scan snippet from a draft markup without opening its documents, and counted an acquisition agreement and two tax protection agreements as qualifying.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The reading review said reads were confined to three matters and the candidate set looked partial; it did not name this matter.
first_error.why: A needed matter appeared in its path search and scan output (the agent called its tax-indemnity document a draft markup at [23]), but when choosing what to read it opened only three other matters and never opened that matter's documents, including its closing tax memorandum.

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review at [80] flagged padding with secondary precedents; the agent demoted them but kept an acquisition matter in the strict list.
other_errors.why: The answer lists an acquisition agreement's tax indemnification clause and two tax protection agreements as qualifying Tax-matter indemnities (evidence seen at [50]-[72]).

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The check review at [92] called the demotion of the two tax protection agreements a possible narrowing and asked to restore them; the agent did.
other_errors.why: The edit restored two tax protection agreements to the headline count of qualifying matters after they had been demoted.

runs.failure_point: It never opened a candidate whose tax-indemnity file name said draft markup, excluded a tax indemnity agreement it had read as unsigned, and counted nine transaction matters with indemnification clauses as qualifying.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The screening review said only four matters were opened while about 60 surfaced; its examples did not include this one.
first_error.why: A needed matter surfaced in the agent's own path searches (its draft-markup tax-indemnity file named in the summary at [28]), but the screening reads covered four other matters and it was never opened, so its closing tax memorandum was never found.

other_errors.critic_note: Reviews in reach asked to verify signature pages, which pushed the same way; none questioned the exclusion.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Search file contents for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It opened one needed matter's tax receivable agreement only and listed the matter as a near miss without reading its other documents, while counting many transaction matters with indemnification clauses as qualifying.

first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [55] named the matter and said it was not checked against its other documents; the agent did not open them (the same review also said its agreement was not a tax indemnity).
first_error.why: The agent opened the matter and read its tax receivable agreement, then listed it as a near miss without reading its other documents, including the closing tax memorandum (evidence seen at [45]-[63]).

other_errors.critic_note: Write and check reviews asked only to verify clauses, signatures and paths.
other_errors.why: The answer counts many transaction matters whose purchase or merger agreements indemnify pre-closing taxes as qualifying Tax matters (evidence seen at [56]-[63]).

divergence: All three runs failed the same two ways. Every run counted transaction matters whose purchase or merger agreements indemnify pre-closing taxes (and, in T0 and T1, tax protection agreements) as qualifying Tax matters, and every run dropped the matter whose proof sits in a closing tax memorandum: T0 and T1 never opened it, having seen only a draft-markup file name or snippet, while T2 read only its tax receivable agreement and called it a near miss. T1 also excluded the standalone tax indemnity agreement as unsigned. Reviews mostly flagged unopened matters in general; in T0 a check review pushed two tax protection agreements back into the count, and the agent followed it.
